_comment: Copy to gemba.conf.json (or point GEMBA_CONF at your copy) and fill in your values. Read by runner/lib.py, runner/build_subject.sh and scenario-01/build_testenv.sh. Never commit your real file.

testenv._comment: the Incus host that runs the web/db containers of the test environment; the runner reaches it over ssh and runs incus there

a._comment: web/db: container names on the test-environment host (web<suffix>/db<suffix>); web_ip/db_ip/gw/bridge: their addresses and Incus bridge there (the scenario default 10.92.0.x is what the published runs used; other addresses work when the data is generated for them, which build_testenv.sh does). out: the generated data under scenario-01/. oc: the subject container on the runner host; subject_net: its Incus bridge (created by build_subject.sh if missing, with subject_net_cidr); subject_ip: optional fixed address; subject_addr_prefix: the start of that address (the runner waits for it after a restore).
